purpose: Audit whether artificial gap exits, rather than published price rules, explain positive results
timing: After observing strict-all-fields-quarantine 2022 and 2023-2026 results; this is an additional disclosed sensitivity, never a blind test
fixed_price_strategy: Unchanged 55/20 day, 20 day N, 2N stop and 0.5N adds; no parameter tuning
price_data_policy: Ignore volume-only archive differences because this strategy consumes no volume. Quarantine any OHLC mismatch between monthly minute aggregation and monthly five-minute, and any raw monthly-vs-daily minute OHLC mismatch. Verify daily source checksums. Never interpolate prices.
report_both: Retain all-fields strict result and OHLC-only result side by side; do not choose best result. Report data-gap-affected campaigns and their net contribution separately. Artificial next-observed-open gap exit remains a scenario, not an executable historical fill.
interpretation: Neither scenario alone proves profitability or authorizes live-entry promotion. If profit depends on artificial gap exits, reject the certification claim.
